title: Phone header snap-zoom into a bills list
summary: A blue phone card materialises on white, the camera snaps into its greeting header and pans across it, whips away, then a bills list with filter chips builds and the camera dives onto one row's status pill before fading to white.
use_when: A mobile finance or billing app with a personal home header and a list screen
A short silent loop for a landing page hero or social post
Showing two screens of a phone app at detail zoom without a full device shot
A light, clean brand where one saturated colour carries the app

look.type_style: geometric grotesk; UI header bold sentence case ~6 % H at close-up; list titles regular ~3 % H, sub-lines small grey; chip labels medium in pill buttons

sfx.event: camera snaps into the phone header (zoom-tier full to detail)
header action icons fade in one by one
whip-pan out of the header into the hard cut
status pill appears beside the zoomed row

structure.shot: white frame; a tall rounded blue card (phone screen, gradient fading to white at the bottom) appears centred, avatar and greeting start
structure.camera: static frame, card itself scales ~0.9 -> 1.0 and drifts slightly left 0.50 -> 1.00
structure.motion: card fades + blurs in from a pale lavender ghost at 0.27, springs.ui ~15 fr (overshoot not measurable, ±0.25 s), solid by f15; avatar dot at f30, greeting starts blur-in f32

structure.shot: close-up of the phone header: status bar (clock, island pill, signal), round avatar and a 2-word greeting; then 2 action icons appear on the right
structure.camera: zoom-tier full -> detail (~3.2x) f33-f38, settles by f53; pan right f60-f75 (content moves left ~185 px/s @1920); drift f90-f128 scale 1.00 -> 0.97; whip up-left f128-f141
structure.motion: zoom springs.cameraIn ~20 fr (overshoot not measurable); greeting blur-in resolves by f45; pan easings.outExpo 15 fr with motion blur at f68; search icon blur-in f75, send icon f83 (stagger ~8 fr, ±0.25 s); whip easings.inExpo 13 fr, heavy motion blur on the last 5 fr

structure.shot: white list screen, no device frame: 2 filter chips (active + idle) at top-left, then 2 bill rows (round icon, title, grey sub-line) build below
structure.camera: push-in 1.00 -> 1.25 over f158-f195 (chip width 106 -> 132 px on the sheet), easings.inOutSine, accelerating into the next zoom from f203
structure.motion: chips fade in from white f141-f150; active chip fills grey f150 then near-black f158 (springs.ui); rows list-assemble: icon then title then sub-line, row stagger ~8 fr (±0.25 s), each easings.outExpo 12 fr (±0.25 s); settled f173

structure.shot: detail tier on the second row: its title huge at left edge, grey sub-line under it, an orange outlined status pill with a dot to its right
structure.camera: zoom-tier element -> detail f203-f218 with motion blur; hold with small drift f225-f240; steps out ~0.8x and pans right f240-f248; hold to f263
structure.motion: zoom easings.inExpo into springs.cameraIn ~15 fr (overshoot not measurable); status pill blur-in + fade from pale f218, sharp by f225 (springs.ui, ±0.25 s); exit at f263: all content blurs and fades to white in ~7 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: empty white frame, identical to frame 0, so the film loops

params.brand: any brand.json: accent fills the phone screen gradient, fg for list text, bg white
params.content.avatar: round user photo or initials for the header
params.content.chips: 2 filter chip labels, first one active
params.content.rows: 2 list rows: {icon, title (1-2 words), sub (2-4 words)}
params.content.status: status pill label (1 word) and its colour, shown beside row 2
params.timing.scale: stretch factor for holds; the zoom snaps (5-15 fr) and whip (13 fr) keep their frame counts
params.loop: true keeps the 21 fr white tail so the last frame equals frame 0

notes: Silent reference, sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured. Measured from 4 fps sheets (±0.25 s). Continuous camera, only one hard cut (f141), hidden by a whip with motion blur; the other two scene changes are zoom-tier snaps, not cuts. Phone appears as a frameless rounded screen, not a full device. Proposed terms (not used as ids): status-pill (coloured outlined status chip with a dot), filter-chips (segmented pill tabs, one active fill).
